qualified_producer_steps: Freeze candidate source patch separately from frozen 14 benchmark target inputs. Candidate target cache must remain absent for every timed run; unchanged dependency artifacts stay pinned.

Run official candidate tools/shared/build.py --ghc "$GHC" --cc "$CC" --optimization 2 --build-dir "$NEW_PRODUCER_1" under guard. This is GHC direct compilation of 121 registered modules and 13 tools, NOT MLF compiler bootstrap. It checks actual source resolution, all inferred interfaces, exhaustiveness, syntax and builtin freshness.

If and only if all prior stages pass and builtin verification fails solely because candidate source identity is stale, preserve that incomplete receipt. Compute identity with candidate tools/shared/builtin_prelude_identity.py "$S". Use that exact candidate producer bin/builtin-prelude "$IDENTITY" to generate canonical stdout into a new evidence file; verify exit/status/stderr and source/tool pins. Do not hand-edit a hash token or reuse the old generator as semantic evidence.

Review canonical generated BuiltinPreludeData.hs against old. Expected semantics-preserving compiler edits should preserve generated content apart from identity; any other delta needs explanation rather than normalization. Install only genuine generator bytes into candidate source, then run official build.py to a NEW producer directory and require complete receipt including fresh literal byte comparison.

Authenticate final receipt with candidate test_direct.authenticate_build against candidate source root and producer/bin; run small verifier/provenance controls: python3 tools/shared/test_builtin_prelude_verification.py and python3 tools/shared/test_provenance.py (do not double-count duplicated verifier controls).

Then run chosen maintained source/type/error/Unicode/lazy checks and explicit selector gap controls with exact source/tool pins.
